source: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Provinces/territories Cartographic Boundary File (lpr_000b21a)
notes: Shoreline-clipped cartographic file. Read per province from Statistics Canada's ArcGIS REST service with a 50 m generalization, reprojected from Statistics Canada Lambert (EPSG:3347) to WGS84, islands and lakes under 150 km² dropped, simplified with mapshaper (weighted Visvalingam, 3.9 km interval, keep-shapes), quantized to 1e4.
